answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an echo bet on surviving 75 epochs of grading, and every karst settlement recomputes the gale schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 75 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
